description: This script automates the configuration and setup process for building firmware or software profiles, including loading YAML profiles, managing feeds, and generating configuration files.

methods.name: run_cmd
methods.description: Executes a command list, optionally printing it if verbose mode is enabled.

methods.name: die
methods.description: Prints messages and exits the program with status 1.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Prints usage information and exits with the given code.

methods.name: load_yaml
methods.description: Loads and merges YAML profile files, handling includes and duplicate tags.

methods.name: load_yaml_list
methods.description: Loads multiple YAML profile files into a single profile dictionary.

methods.name: extract_sha1_from_revision
methods.description: Validates and extracts SHA-1 hash from revision strings.

methods.name: handle_feed_revision
methods.description: Processes feed information, validating revisions and appending to feeds list.
